content: Efesa khuapui letah Paul
Apolo cawh Korin khuapui letah a ung thlang chung takhei Paul cawh ma raang chung sahlo khah tlawnglai ka, Efesa khuapui khah a va phah. Ma leco hningzuitu thaikhehpaw sahlo khah hmuh he ka,
“Naa zing ning tai khei Thlawpaw Pathai naa ting thah maw?” tatah a hae he. Aaning sahlo taco, “Ting bei peh. Thlawpaw Pathai a ung tahpaw kaa thui bang tlung be,” tatah aa chai.
Macawtaco Paul tah, “A cang caco, zehapaw baptisma maw naa cang?” tatah tah he ka, “Johan baptisma,” tatah aa palei.

Paul taco, “Johan baptisma cawh angepachihnah baptisma a cang. Johan taco zawpuipaw khah ama a hninglang tei a vong leimeipaw cawh zing rua pawtah khei a ching he, ma paw cawh Zisu a cang,” tatah a tah he.
Mataico, aaning sahlo cawh ma bia khah aa thui tihtah Abuipaw Zisu ming tah baptisma cawh a cang he.
Paul taco aa cung letah a kih cawh a pahnia tihtah aa cung lekhei Thlawpaw Pathai cawh za tlung ka, rei thuilypaw sahlo khei aa rei thlaw he ka, bia cawh aa phy.
Ma cawngsaw sahlo cawh aa dawngkasawny tah pahrawhluihning hrong a cang he.
Mataico, Paul cawh synagog lang a nae ka, thlah thung chung Khazing painah raang kong cawh aa thuithai nápawtah raechah ngetei tah a rei.

Canghrasala, aaning sahlo chung letei chykheh cawh aa lung lai ngetei ka, zing du bei he. Khazing Langpui chah be tatah zawpui thuí khei aa tah. Macawtaco Paul takhei aaning sahlo cawh a seisai he. Hningzuitu sahlo khah a chui he ka, Tiranas cawngpahnah ing lekhei a ning tating tah bia a reihrui tei he.
Ma hraco kung hning chung a tua cawtah Asia raang chung letei a ungpaw Juda cawngsaw vytei le Grik cawngsaw vytei taco Abuipaw bia cawh aa thui.
Khazing tah Paul hmang khei ningang chuipaw hming a tua.
Ama a pavua le pai sahlo khah a dang lypaw tongsah rua pawtah tle lai he ka, a tongpaw cawh aa danglynah taco thlaw he ka, thlawpaw pialuipaw tah a piasai he.

Thlawpaw pialuipaw papia lai rua pawtei a khia laipaw Juda cawngsaw thaikhehpaw sahlo tah khachia papianah lekhei Abuipaw Zisu ming khah hmang a pachia he. Aaning sahlo taco, “Paul tei a reipaw Zisu ming tah ka pia law kaa ca tah,” tatah aa tah lai.
Ma hratei a tah laipaw he cawh Juda tlangbui macang, Skeva a sawcapaw pasarih tlaw a cang he.
Ning kheh cawh thlawpaw pialuipaw tah aaning tlaw cawh, “Zisu cawh hnih neh ka, Paul zong ka hni, canghrasala naaning heh aho sahlo maw naa cang?” tatah a chai he.

Mataico, thlawpaw pialuipaw tei a pahrangpaw cawngsawpaw taco a zyhno he ka, a dunahpaw khei a tua he. Ma hratei a sah pui tah a tuanah caw he taco aa thlekalong tah aa thi cho khei ma ing taico a sai he.
Ma hratei a cangpaw khah Efesa khuapui letei a ungpaw Juda cawngsaw le Grik cawngsaw sahlo tah aa thui tihtah aa zongmingtei co aa ci tho ka, Abuipaw Zisu ming cawh aa pasang lo leimei.
Taico, zingtu sahlo mehlupui zong cawh a vong he ka, aa tuapaw hmingchahly khah ming hringpaw hai letah aa phy.
Ca-ia a thaipaw cawngsaw sahlo zong tah aa cabu sahlo khah va tle he ka, zawpui hme lekhei me tah aa ro. Aa cabu sahlo mai cawh aa patong tihtah a pahlawng tah ngung tangka
50,000 mai a cang.
Ma hraco Abuipaw bia cawh a ka lo leimei ka, hmingtuakhynah khatah a chang lo leimei.
Ma vytei hming a tlung khy taihei, Paul cawh Masidonia le Akhaia raang sahlo cahrong khei Jerusalem lang khah sei pawtah a pachia. “Ma leco ka phah khy taitah Rom zong ka va tlongpai a,” tatah a tah.
Asia raang chung letah a cawngpe a ung kaa lekhei ama a bawtu cawngsaw pahning a cangpaw he Timote le Erasta cawh Masidonia lang khah a thlaw he.
Ma cai hrawnghrang leco Abuipaw langpui kong letah hnahnawhnah biatah teitah a chuh.
Artimi khazingno lingthlaw khah ngung tei a tuapaw Demitria aa tahpaw ngung sysahpaw takhei lingthlaw a tua thaipaw sahlo cawtah tangka hmuhnah rai a hlupui a chuakhui.
Aaning sahlo le ma rai khatei a peitle tah rai a hrepaw sahlo khah hmingkheh tah y he ka, “Vesaw sahlo, ma rai taihei tangka ahlupui kaa hmuh tah cawh naa hnipaw a cang.

Taico ma Paul aa tahpaw cawngsawpaw tahei Efesa khuapui letah mehnung hlupui le Asia raang letei cawngsaw ahlupui khah aa lungsingsah he ka, lang a pavesah he tah cawh thui he ceh ka, naa hmuh. Ama taco cawngsaw tei tuapaw khazing sahlo cawh khazing hmuisui cang bei he tatah a tah.

Ma hratei a cang caco, kaa rai heh hmezawnah hnui khawhly tah a ungpaw long cang lytah a laisuipaw Artimi khazingno behnah ing zong silang hnui be ca ka, Asia raang le khazawpui tei aa behpaw khazingno a rungnawnah zerei lytah a ung a,” tatah a tah he.
Ma bia cawh aa thui tihtah aa thingae ngetei ka, “Efesa cawngsaw aa Artimi khazingno cawh laisui ky seh!” tatah aa y.
A ry hlai tah khuapui pungpaluh letah buainah a chuh. Paul tei Masidonia taitah khua a va tlong hruipaw he Kaia le Aristarka khah tle he ka, vaitlang a pungnah ing lang khah aa seikhui he.
Paul cawh zawpui hme lekhei chua a du naná teitah hningzuitu sahlo takhei aa thly.
Ma raang chung letei abui macang a cangpaw he a vesaw sahlo takhei hmai vaitlang a pungnah ing lang chua ly ruapaw tah bia aa caw.

Macawtaco thaikhehpaw takhei sangkheh kong khei y he ka, thaikhehpaw tah ahringpaw kong khei y he ka, a pahmonah pawhe cawh lu a ri thlang. Cawngsaw a hlu cai taco zecawtamaw ma lekhei aa chua tahpaw hmai khah hnih bei he.

Juda cawngsaw sahlo takhei Alekzandar cawh a hmelang va nang he ka, zawpui thaikhehpaw takhei a reipaw bia khah aa yso. Alekzandar taco zawpui hme letah a reikainah bia rei rua pawtah khei zawpui cawh de law tatah a kiá khei a tuapah he.
Canghrasala Juda cawngsaw a cang tahpaw khah aa hni tihtah aa zongmingtei co hmokheh teitah, “Efesa cawngsaw sahlo aa Artimi khazingno cawh rungnaw ky seh,” tatah suimehlang pahning chung a y he.

Khuapui cazi a cangpaw taco zawpuipaw cawh de law, tah he ka, “Efesa cawngsaw sahlo, Efesa khuapui cawh a rungnawpaw Artimi khazingno behnah ing le avai lang tah a tlahpaw a lingthlaw a mingkaitu a cang tahpaw alui cung pungpaluh tah hnih thlang bei he maw?
Macawtaco ahotahmai ma bia heh eikhypaw a cangly cawtah naa de a hy thlang, pacang huaha lytah zehming hmai tuapaw cang be.
Ma cawngsaw sahlo naa va chuakhuipaw he tahei kaa behnah ing zong rawh be ca he ka, kaa khazingno zong reipachia hrah bei he.
Mataico, Demitria le a vesaw raihretu sahlo tah taza aa cui du he a cang caco, biacenah ing zong hong thlang he ka, biacetu sahlo zong a ung thlang he. Aa cui khy thlang he.
Hming sangkheh va chuakhui naa du vy a cang caco, khuapui khongsil letah biachawnah tuapaw a cang.

Ma hratei a cang ly caco, atoning letei hming a cangpaw rawng tahei kaaning cawh hnahnawhnah naa chuasah tatah bia hnui khy peh ka, ma hratei a cang caco aaning bia kaa palei khy nápaw he ung be, taico zecawtamaw tatah ma heh a hrang a hnui lypaw a cang,” a tah he.
Ma hratei bia a rei khy taico a pahmopaw mehnung vytei khah a disah he.

footnotes.text: Ngung tangka cawh Grik rei tah drakma aa tah. Phae kheh cawh ning kheh nihlo a cang.
